title: Newly Renovated Home North of Nashville
description:
This spacious two-story home boasts a large balcony and patio with plenty of seating, a grill, firepit, and a charming front yard perfect for outdoor activities. This 3 bedroom, 2 bath home is ideal for families, friends, or anyone looking for a fun and comfortable getaway. With easy access to SR 386 and I-65, you can explore all that Nashville has to offer. If you need even more space, we have an adjacent single-level home with 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms available for booking as well.

Other things to note
This home is pet friendly to dogs only with a two pet maximum. Please make sure you select your pets at the time of booking as a $150 fee is collected for reservations including animals. We do also follow breed and weight restrictions please reach out to us directly for more information!
